notes: CR 616.1e-f: after one replacement applies, the ones still applicable apply in turn, each once (CR 614.5). Two Fiery Emancipations ('If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead') both apply to Shock's 2 damage: 2 -> 6 -> 18, the opponent goes to 2. Either order gives the same result, so nobody is asked: the step carries no decisions, and an ask would fail the pack. Before the fix two matching damage replacements raised NotImplementedError (B-69).
